summary.text: Steve Menard is the Republican candidate for the Alaska House of Representatives, District 29, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He ran unsuccessfully for the House in District 28 in 2022 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Steve Menard was the Republican candidate in the 2022 general election for Alaska House District 28, which Jesse Sumner won with 61.7 percent to Menard's 38.3 percent.
In 2024 he again ran in District 28 and lost to Elexie Moore in the second round of a ranked-choice count, 50.1 percent to 49.9 percent.
He advanced from the August 18, 2026 primary in District 29, where incumbent Garret Nelson is also a Republican candidate.
